mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, title, description, priority, owner, owner_user_id, category, board_column, start_date, due_date, req_id, req_doc_id, progress, is_blocked AS blocked, blocked_reason, blocked_by_task_id, note, completed_at, recur_type, recur_next_id, remind_at, remind_target, remind_sent, deleted_at, sort_order, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY board_column, sort_order, id
SELECT FROM task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY deleted_at DESC

SELECT t.id, t.workspace_id, t.title, t.description, t.priority, t.owner, t.owner_user_id, t.category, t.board_column, t.start_date, t.due_date, t.req_id, t.req_doc_id, t.progress, t.is_blocked AS blocked, t.blocked_reason, t.blocked_by_task_id, t.note, t.completed_at, t.recur_type, t.recur_next_id, t.remind_at, t.remind_target, t.remind_sent, t.deleted_at, t.sort_order, t.created_at, t.updated_at, w.name AS workspace_name FROM task t LEFT JOIN workspace w ON w.id = t.workspace_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.workspace_id IN (SELECT workspace_id FROM workspace_member WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AND (t.owner_user_id = #{userId}
OR (t.owner_user_id IS NULL AND t.owner = #{displayName}) ) AND t.board_column != 'done' ORDER BY (t.due_date IS NULL), t.due_date, FIELD(t.priority, 'P0', 'P1', 'P2', 'P3'), t.updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (id, workspace_id, title, description, priority, owner, owner_user_id, category, board_column, start_date, due_date, req_id, req_doc_id, progress, is_blocked, blocked_reason, blocked_by_task_id, note, completed_at, recur_type, remind_at, remind_target, remind_sent, sort_order, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{priority}, #{owner}, #{ownerUserId}, #{category}, #{boardColumn}, #{startDate}, #{dueDate}, #{reqId}, #{reqDocId}, #{progress}, #{blocked}, #{blockedReason}, #{blockedByTaskId}, #{note}, #{completedAt}, #{recurType}, #{remindAt}, #{remindTarget}, #{remindSent}, #{sortOrder}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, priority = #{priority}, owner = #{owner}, owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, category = #{category}, board_column = #{boardColumn}, start_date = #{startDate}, due_date = #{dueDate}, req_id = #{reqId}, req_doc_id = #{reqDocId}, progress = #{progress}, is_blocked = #{blocked}, blocked_reason = #{blockedReason}, blocked_by_task_id = #{blockedByTaskId}, note = #{note}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, recur_type = #{recurType}, remind_at = #{remindAt}, remind_target = #{remindTarget}, remind_sent = #{remindSent}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE task SET deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE task SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM task WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at < #{cutoff}
SELECT FROM task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND board_column != 'done' AND remind_sent = 0 AND remind_at IS NOT NULL AND remind_at < #{before} ORDER BY remind_at
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET remind_sent = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE task SET recur_next_id = #{recurNextId} WHERE id = #{id} AND recur_next_id IS NULL
UPDATE task SET recur_next_id = NULL WHERE recur_next_id = #{taskId}
UPDATE task SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), -1) FROM task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND board_column = #{boardColumn} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET req_id = NULL, req_doc_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId}
